name: Familia Stones
description: The Familia Stones are a Black P. Stones branch within the People Nation, founded in 1992 in Chicago's Albany Park neighborhood by a Future Stones member known as 'Broleeo.' Originally operating as the Puerto Rican Familia Stones near Sunnyside and Kimball, they dropped the 'Puerto Rican' designation in 1995 as membership expanded beyond Puerto Rican recruits. The gang later spread to the Streamwood suburb and has been the subject of federal drug trafficking prosecutions.
